Definition: of Chaldee origin (compare H1004 and H6719); fishing-house; Bethsaida, a place in Palestine:--Bethsaida.
BiblicalUsage: The name Bethsaida appears in the New Testament. It turns up in Matthew 11:21, Luke 9:10 and Luke 10:13.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Bethsaida marks real ground in God's story, not a made-up setting.
